description: Statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl, app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy-bms/COCRDUP.CPY and the shipped ASCII fixture, and NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing these programs is empirically impossible in this environment - there is no z/OS and no CICS emulator, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled and refuses a PROCEDURE ... USING program under -x, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, app/cpy/CUSTREC.cpy carries literal TAB characters that break parsing, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. That substitutes the PROVENANCE of the expected values and nothing else (AAP 0.7.6, practice B12, risk R-A, where the substitution is escalated for explicit user confirmation rather than silently absorbed). Every byte below is read out of three places and no fourth: the two-way lock check at app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl:1441-1449, the field offsets of app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, and row index 0 of src/test/resources/fixtures/carddata.txt. Nothing here is a measurement of a run and it must never be described as one. THIS IS THE FOLDER'S RECORD OF WHY THE 9200 RESP CHECKS ARE BINARY, WHICH IS THE BOUNDARY OF GATE G47 FOR THIS PROGRAM. The check at :1441-1449 reads IF WS-RESP-CD EQUAL TO DFHRESP(NORMAL) CONTINUE ELSE SET INPUT-ERROR TO TRUE, IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF SET COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE TO TRUE, GO TO 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT - a TWO-WAY IF, not an EVALUATE. Contrast 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD at :1392-1412, which case08.json owns: THREE ordered arms, WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL), WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND) carrying its own DID-NOT-FIND-ACCTCARD-COMBO literal from :1400, and WHEN OTHER, which builds the detailed eighty-byte file-error message at :1407-1411. 9200's lock check has NO NOTFND ARM AND NO FILE-ERROR MESSAGE, so NOTFND, DUPKEY, DUPREC, INVREQ, NOTOPEN, LENGERR, NOTAUTH and every other condition are INDISTINGUISHABLE at this call site and every one of them produces the single literal 'Could not lock record for update'. A translation that surfaced distinct outcomes here would be ADDING BEHAVIOUR, which the migration forbids outright. The consequence for gate G47 is worth stating in full, because it is the kind of thing a later reader mistakes for a gap: the whole reachable outcome surface of COCRDUPC is 9100's three arms plus the TWO binary checks of 9200 - this lock check and the rewrite post-check at :1488-1492 - and FILE STATUS '10' (end of file) and '22' (duplicate) ARE UNREACHABLE ANYWHERE IN THIS PROGRAM. COCRDUPC issues no STARTBR and no READNEXT, no WRITE and no DELETE; its only file-changing verb is the single REWRITE at :1478; and card.CardRepository defines neither an add nor a delete method at all. No case is missing: those two statuses have no call site here to be reached from. THE UNIT IS THE SERVICE, NOT THE CONTROLLER. unitKind is SERVICE: card.CardUpdateService is constructed through its own constructor over a fixture-backed card.CardRepository - readForUpdateByCardNumber for the READ ... UPDATE at :1427-1436, and rewrite for the REWRITE at :1477-1483 which this case asserts is NEVER CALLED - and writeProcessing is invoked as a plain method on a plain object. There is NO MockMvc, no servlet container, no HTTP layer and no JobLauncher anywhere in the path (gate G51). BATCH_JOB and COMPONENT are both illegal for this program and neither is used. A DIRECT CONSEQUENCE WORTH STATING SO IT IS NOT READ AS AN OMISSION: because the unit is the service, this case's fingerprint is the UNWRITTEN record, the outcome state and the return message, and it does NOT assemble the seventeen-field COCRDUP screen. expectedResponse is therefore null and no xxxO, xxxA or xxxL item appears anywhere below. THE LOCK FAILURE IS INJECTED, AND THE INJECTION IS NAMED RATHER THAN IMPLIED (practice B1). No arrangement of fixture rows can make a read-for-update fail: the seeded row 0 exists and is keyed exactly as the RIDFLD addresses it, so the data would answer NORMAL every time. forcedOutcomes therefore drives CardRepository.readForUpdateByCardNumber - RepositoryOperation.readForUpdate, which is the READ ... UPDATE at :1427-1436 and no other call site - to a NON-NORMAL outcome, and the exact constants are pinned: outcome NOT_FOUND is common.FileStatus.Outcome.NOT_FOUND, resp 13 is common.FileStatus.NOTFND, the value DFHRESP(NOTFND) carries, and resp2 0 is common.FileStatus.NO_REASON_CODE. Those are precisely what CardRepository.CardReadResult.notFound() reports, so the declaration and the factory agree byte for byte rather than merely nearly. NOT_FOUND IS CHOSEN DELIBERATELY OVER OTHER, and the choice is the argument: NOTFND is the one response that 9100 gives an ordered arm and a message of its own to, so pinning it here proves the collapse rather than asserting it - the same RESP that produces 'Did not find cards for this search condition' fifty lines earlier produces 'Could not lock record for update' here, and nothing in the fingerprint could tell you which condition arose. It also returns NO RECORD, which matters twice below. THE SEED. Rows 0, 1 and 2 of fixtures/carddata.txt, byte-identical to the same rows of app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt, with row 0 composed here from the CVACT02Y spans rather than pasted so every offset is checkable against the copybook (practice B11): CARD-NUM X(16) 0500024453765740 at [1-16], CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) 00000000050 at [17-27], CARD-CVV-CD 9(03) 747 at [28-30], CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50) 'Aniya Von' followed by forty-one spaces at [31-80], CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10) 2023-03-09 at [81-90], CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01) Y at [91] and FILLER X(59) at [92-150]. 16 + 11 + 3 + 50 + 10 + 1 + 59 = 150, and that sum is the self-check: a FILLER dropped or shortened makes the total wrong immediately (gates G19 and G21). CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE IS MISSPELLED IN app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:9 and is reproduced verbatim as a field name in every map below (requirement I1); repairing the spelling would leave the differ looking for a field the decoder never produces, which is a silent parity break rather than a loud one. The fixture is in ascending CARD-NUM order, which is CARDDAT primary-key order, so the fixture line index IS the expectedFinalState row index. Rows 1 and 2 - Ward Jones on 0683586198171516 and Enrico Rosenbaum on 0923877193247330 - are seeded and asserted UNCHANGED, which is how this case shows the refusal touched no row at all rather than the wrong one. NO NORMALISATION IS DECLARED, and that is a measurement rather than an omission: carddata.txt rows are already the full 150 bytes with a space-filled FILLER, and the two markers ParityCase defines belong to cardxref, whose rows are 36 bytes against a 50-byte copybook, and to USRSEC. THE INBOUND PAYLOAD, AND ALL OF IT IS PAYLOAD (gate G37). No conversation state is held server-side. EIBCALEN is 160 + 329 = 489: the shared CARDDEMO-COMMAREA of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, whose sixteen items sum to 160, followed by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA at app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl:274-321, which is CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION X(1) plus CCUP-OLD-DETAILS 89 plus CCUP-NEW-DETAILS 89 plus CARD-UPDATE-RECORD 150. The extension is carried as one 329-byte image because that is exactly how :396-400 slices what came back. EVERY INBOUND BYTE HERE IS case16.json'S, WITHOUT EXCEPTION - the same sixteen commarea items, the same 329-byte extension image, the same seven map fields and the same AID - so this case and the folder's one successful save differ in NOTHING ON THE WAY IN. The only difference is the forced repository outcome, and that is what makes the refusal attributable to the lock check and to nothing else. CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION is 'N', the 88 CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED at :286. THE CCUP-OLD-DETAILS SNAPSHOT DELIBERATELY AGREES WITH THE STORED ROW in all six fields 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC would compare - CCUP-OLD-CVV-CD 747, CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME 'ANIYA VON' padded to X(50) and already upper-cased by the INSPECT ... CONVERTING at :1356-1358, CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR 2023, CCUP-OLD-EXPMON 03, CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY 09 and CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD Y - with CCUP-OLD-ACCTID 00000000050 and CCUP-OLD-CARDID 0500024453765740 completing the 89 bytes. THAT AGREEMENT IS THE POINT OF THE CASE. Had the snapshot been stale, a lock check wrongly skipped would have landed on case17.json's changed-by-another refusal and the case would still have looked right; because it agrees, a skipped lock check falls through to case16.json's SUCCESSFUL REWRITE instead - a mutated row 0 carrying CVV 000, 'MARIA DEL CARMEN VON', 2027-11-09 and status N - which no expectation below tolerates. Only a correctly implemented binary lock check can produce this outcome. Position 90 of the 329-byte image is where the three cases are told apart: 'Y' here and in case16, 'N' in case17. CCUP-NEW-DETAILS carries the user's edits, every value stated rather than left to be inferred: CCUP-NEW-ACCTID 00000000050, CCUP-NEW-CARDID 0500024453765740, CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME 'MARIA DEL CARMEN VON' padded to X(50), CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR 2027, CCUP-NEW-EXPMON 11, CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY 09 and CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD N, all of them valid - the name is letters and spaces only as :823-828 demands, the status satisfies 88 FLG-YES-NO-VALID at :91, the month satisfies 88 VALID-MONTH VALUES 1 THRU 12 at :95 and the year satisfies 88 VALID-YEAR VALUES 1950 THRU 2099 at :99. CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD IS THREE SPACES and cannot be anything else: declared at :306, it appears exactly once more, at :1464, as a SENDING item, it is assigned nowhere in the program, the COCRDUP map has no CVV field at all, and INITIALIZE CCUP-NEW-DETAILS at :586 is the last thing to touch it. Populating it 'helpfully' would erase a defect the folder exists to pin (practice B5). The CARD-UPDATE-RECORD span still holds nothing but its INITIALIZE residue - SPACES in the PIC X items, ZEROS in CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) and CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD PIC 9(03) - because it is written nowhere but 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING, and on this pass 9200 abandons before it writes. The seven writable xxxI items are carried as mapFields at the widths app/cpy-bms/COCRDUP.CPY declares, because 1100-RECEIVE-MAP re-reads them on this pass and they must agree with the extension's CCUP-NEW-* values byte for byte. PF5 IS PRESSED: aid DFHPF5, which app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy:12 renders as the 88 CCARD-AID-PFK05 VALUE 'PFK05'. The case is SELF-CONTAINED (practice B9) - it declares its own complete pre-state and depends on no other case having run. THE AID SURVIVES COERCION, :413-424, AND ONLY BECAUSE OF THE STATE. SET PFK-INVALID TO TRUE runs unconditionally at :413. The validity test then admits CCARD-AID-ENTER OR CCARD-AID-PFK03 OR (CCARD-AID-PFK05 AND CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED) OR (CCARD-AID-PFK12 AND NOT CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED), and it is the THIRD limb that matches: PF5 was pressed AND the state is 'N'. So PFK-VALID holds and the coercion IF PFK-INVALID SET CCARD-AID-ENTER TO TRUE at :422-424 DOES NOT FIRE. Had the state been anything else, PF5 would have been silently rewritten to ENTER, 9200 would never have been performed, and the lock check this case is about would not have been reached at all. DISPATCH. The ordered EVALUATE TRUE at :429 passes arm one at :435-439 - it needs PFK03, or CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE, or CCUP-CHANGES-FAILED, with the card-list mapset, and the state is 'N' - then arm two at :482-485, arm three at :502-505 and the :517-518 pair, and reaches WHEN OTHER at :535, which performs 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, then 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, then 3000-SEND-MAP. In 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS the skip at :685-693 fires because CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED already holds, so 1230, 1240, 1250 and 1260 DO NOT RUN on a confirm pass and no edit can write a message. WS-RETURN-MSG is therefore still the SPACES that SET WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF TO TRUE left in it at :384, and that is what decides both the guarded SET below and the inner EVALUATE at the end. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, ARM (e), :988-1001 (gate G30). The ordered EVALUATE TRUE at :949 is walked arm by arm. (a) WHEN CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :954 fails, the state being 'N' rather than LOW-VALUES or SPACES. (b) WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK12 at :958 fails, PF5 having been pressed, so the 9000-READ-DATA re-fetch at :961-965 does not run. (c) WHEN CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS at :971 fails, 'N' not being 'S'. (d) WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK at :982 fails, 'N' not being 'E'. (e) WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED AND CCARD-AID-PFK05 at :988-989 MATCHES - both operands are true - so PERFORM 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING THRU 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT runs at :990-991. THE BARE SECOND TEST OF THE SAME 88-LEVEL at :1006-1007 IS THEREFORE NEVER REACHED; that arm is case15.json's, where the AID is ENTER and (e)'s extra conjunct fails. Arm (g) at :1011 and the WHEN OTHER abend at :1019-1026 are not reached. 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING, :1420-1449, AND IT STOPS AT :1449. MOVE CC-CARD-NUM TO WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM at :1425 sets the RIDFLD; the MOVE CC-ACCT-ID-N TO WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID on the line above at :1424 is COMMENTED OUT and stays that way (practice B5). EXEC CICS READ FILE(LIT-CARDFILENAME) UPDATE RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) KEYLENGTH(LENGTH OF WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) INTO(CARD-RECORD) LENGTH(LENGTH OF CARD-RECORD) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) at :1427-1436 addresses file 'CARDDAT ' with a 16-BYTE KEY into a 150-BYTE record and takes the UPDATE lock; it maps onto readForUpdateByCardNumber and is driven to NOTFND. THE ELSE LIMB THEN TAKES THREE STEPS AND THE ASYMMETRY BETWEEN THE FIRST TWO IS THE SUBTLETY OF THE ARM. SET INPUT-ERROR TO TRUE at :1444 is UNGUARDED. The message SET at :1445-1447 IS GUARDED by IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF - and because nothing on this path had written a message, the guard admits, so COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE is set and WS-RETURN-MSG becomes 'Could not lock record for update' from the 88 at :205-206. Contrast :1491, where the REWRITE-failure SET LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED is NOT guarded at all; that asymmetry is real rather than a transcription slip, and it is case19.json's subject. Then GO TO 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT at :1448 - one of this program's 21 GO TO statements, all of them FORWARD, restructured while preserving the evaluation order and the fall-through outcome exactly (rule R7). WHAT THE GO TO SKIPS, ASSERTED ITEM BY ITEM RATHER THAN LEFT TO INFERENCE. (1) PERFORM 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC THRU ...-EXIT at :1453-1454 DOES NOT RUN, so THE OPTIMISTIC-CONCURRENCY CHECK IS NOT PERFORMED AT ALL: 'Record changed by some one else. Please review' from the 88 at :207-208 appears NOWHERE below, DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE is not set, and the write-back at :1512-1517 does not happen - so THE INBOUND CCUP-OLD-* SNAPSHOT SURVIVES UNMODIFIED, which is the sharpest difference from case17.json, where 9300 ran and refreshed all six items from the stored record. (2) The image assembly at :1461-1475 does not run, so the CVV-zeroing defect of :1464-1465 DOES NOT OCCUR and CARD-CVV-CD is still 747 in the stored row; if it ever reads 000 in this file, the rewrite was not skipped and the case is wrong. (3) The EXEC CICS REWRITE at :1477-1483 does not run: CardRepository.rewrite IS NOT CALLED, which expectedWrites asserts positively by being empty. (4) The post-check at :1488-1492 does not run, so LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED is not set and 'Update of record failed' from the 88 at :209-210 appears NOWHERE below. (5) One more thing follows from the forced NOTFND specifically: the read returned NO RECORD, so nothing was ever delivered into CARD-RECORD and the INSPECT ... CONVERTING LIT-LOWER TO LIT-UPPER at :1499-1501 never executed. The stored CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME is the original mixed-case 'Aniya Von' in this case AND in case17.json, but for different reasons: there the record was read and folded IN MEMORY only, here no record was read at all. THE OUTCOME. Back in arm (e), the inner EVALUATE TRUE at :992-1001 is ordered and every arm of it tests an 88-level ON WS-RETURN-MSG, so which arm is taken depends on the text that field now holds. It holds the lock literal, so the FIRST ARM, WHEN COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE at :993, MATCHES: SET CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR TO TRUE at :994, so CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION becomes 'L', the 88 at :289 (gate G30). WHEN LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED, WHEN DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE and WHEN OTHER are all left unreached, and WHEN OTHER is the one that would have declared success. THE STATE IS 'L', NOT 'F', NOT 'S' AND NOT 'C'. 'L' IS A MEMBER OF TWO GROUPING 88s AT ONCE, and the dual membership is load-bearing downstream: CCUP-CHANGES-MADE VALUES 'E', 'N', 'C', 'L', 'F' at :282-284 and CCUP-CHANGES-FAILED VALUES 'L', 'F' at :288. It is the CHANGES-FAILED membership that makes main-EVALUATE arm four at :517-518 and arm one's third WHEN at :438-439 reachable ON THE NEXT INVOCATION, which is how the user is returned to a fresh search rather than left on the confirm screen (gate G30). MESSAGES, AND EXACTLY WHERE EACH ONE LIVES. The service's one observable message is WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :173, and it now carries 'Could not lock record for update' - thirty-two characters padded on the right to the declared seventy-five, byte-exact from the 88 at :205-206. It is asserted on the width-free DISPLAY_LINE channel because neither fixed-width channel is 75: WS_MESSAGE_80 is eighty and SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 is seventy-eight, while this map declares ERRMSGI at X(80) in app/cpy-bms/COCRDUP.CPY:108. THE SCREEN CONSEQUENCES BELONG TO THE CONTROLLER AND ARE RECORDED HERE RATHER THAN ASSERTED, because the class boundary is real: 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG arm 7 at :1153-1154, WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR, sets INFORM-FAILURE, whose literal is 'Changes unsuccessful. Please try again' from :170-171 - thirty-eight characters padded to the INFOMSGI X(40) width - and :1163 moves WS-RETURN-MSG into ERRMSGO, where the same lock literal is padded to X(80). NOTE THAT ARM 8 AT :1155-1156, WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED, SETS THE SAME INFORM-FAILURE TEXT: the info line alone cannot distinguish 'L' from 'F', and only the state character and the error message can. That is precisely the pairing case19.json completes, and it is why this case pins the error message rather than the info line. No COBOL DISPLAY is emitted on this path. NEGATIVE ASSERTIONS, each verified by exhaustive search rather than assumed. NO CARDAIX ACCESS: LIT-CARDFILENAME-ACCT-PATH PIC X(8) VALUE 'CARDAIX ' is declared at :253-254 and REFERENCED NOWHERE in the program, and both account-id MOVEs into the RIDFLD, at :1379 and :1424, are commented out - so gate G45 holds in its strongest form, the alternate index being a finder method on the single CardRepository rather than a second table, and this program never invoking it at all. NO THANK-YOU AND NO INVALID-KEY TEXT: CSMSG01Y's CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU and CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY have zero references in COCRDUPC. NO WRITE, NO ADD AND NO DELETE anywhere, in the program or in the repository. NO VERSION COLUMN, NO TIMESTAMP COLUMN, NO SEQUENCE COLUMN, NO DDL AND NO MIGRATION SCRIPT of any kind (gate G44): the concurrency control this program carries is a field-by-field comparison against a re-read record, and on this path it does not even run. NO ABEND: there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' anywhere in COCRDUPC, which is why expectedReturnCode is 0 and why gate G35 is inapplicable rather than merely unasserted. WHY expectedFinalState IS STATED IN FULL EVEN THOUGH NOTHING WAS WRITTEN. An absent expectation proves nothing: it cannot distinguish a rewrite that was skipped from a rewrite that happened and was never checked. So all three seeded rows are pinned BYTE-IDENTICAL TO THE SEED, field by field and as whole 150-byte images, and row 0 is the load-bearing one - CARD-CVV-CD 747 (not 000), CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 'Aniya Von' padded to fifty (not 'MARIA DEL CARMEN VON'), CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 2023-03-09 (not 2027-11-09) and CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y (not N). Any one of those four reading case16.json's value would mean the lock check was skipped. The empty expectedWrites list and the three unchanged rows are two halves of one assertion, and expectedDatasets completes it by pinning zero rows at 150 bytes on the WRITES channel - the positive form of 'the file was addressed and nothing was written to it' - and three at 150 bytes on the FINAL_STATE channel. DETERMINISM. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:33, the same instant case01.json pins and the instant this source's own version footer carries (practice B7); the code page is named US-ASCII explicitly and is never the platform default (practice B8); every field value is given at its exact declared width with its exact trailing spaces, and the comparison is field by field rather than as one string, which is what gate G17 requires of FieldDiffer and what the field maps exist for; and the injected outcome is a fixed constant, NOT_FOUND with RESP 13 and RESP2 0, so nothing here depends on timing, on a race or on a real lock manager. Gates asserted: G15 as case 18 of 20; G18 by diffing to zero; G19 at the 150-byte width; G21 with FILLER present and space-filled; G30 three times over - arm (e) taken where the bare arm (f) is not, the walked outer EVALUATE, and the inner EVALUATE stopping at its FIRST arm - plus 'L''s dual 88 membership and what it unlocks on the next pass; G37 with the whole conversation state in the payload and none on the server; G44 with no version column and no DDL; G45 as the negative CARDAIX assertion; G47 as the binary lock check together with the explicit record that '10' and '22' are unreachable in this program; and G51 by driving the service with no HTTP in the path. G32, G35 and G39 are deliberately NOT encoded: all 21 GO TO statements in this program are forward, there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' at all, and this screen has no pagination. RULES. review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided.', so NO user-specified rule governs this fixture and none has been invented; their absence is not treated as licence to lower the bar. It is held instead to enterprise best practice as the AAP records it - B1 with the injected outcome named down to its FileStatus constants rather than left as a magic number, B3 with every reference input under app/cbl, app/cpy, app/cpy-bms and app/data read and not one byte written, B4 no silent scope creep, B5 the CVV defect, the two commented-out MOVEs and the unguarded/guarded SET asymmetry all preserved as written, B7 deterministic and non-interactive, B8 explicit widths, trailing spaces and code page, B9 self-contained, B11 hand-verified offsets summing to 150, and B12 with the provenance limitation documented and escalated rather than absorbed.

expectedMessages.text: Could not lock record for update
